summary: Ro Khanna actively champions ending U.S. military aid to Israel, introducing restrictions and criticizing the IDF after reporting settler detention during his West Bank visit. His record remains inconsistent: earlier votes targeted Palestinian advocacy, and he backed January’s aid package, which defunded UNRWA. He said Republicans “snuck” provisions in; he subsequently opposed February’s package and separately cosponsored UNRWA restoration. Ceasefire advocacy by November 2023 and support for recognizing genocide strengthen his current stance, without erasing those contrary votes.
